research_scope: Correct representation-instability of 80% XOR feature gate under tautologies, duplicate CNF clauses, duplicate literals, permutation and polarity rename, without changing CNF SAT semantics.

policy.old: Use unchanged E3 select_verified_xor(rows,n,'adaptive_80') on raw source, count denominator all original clauses.
policy.new: Build deterministic normalized CNF: within each clause remove repeated literals; if both polarities of a variable present, drop tautology; sort literals canonically; deduplicate identical canonical clauses; retain empty original clauses. Feed unique non-taut source core into unchanged exact-source XOR extractor. Choose XOR only if verified full XOR clause allocation and >=1 source equation and >=80% of NORMALIZED core clauses converted. Every removed raw original is proven tautology or same canonical clause; complete SAT model always replayed on FULL ORIGINAL source. On scan budget abstention or under threshold, fallback raw-original CMS with feature-scan cost paid.
policy.expected_invariance: new semantic-core coverage should be insensitive to any tautology padding, exact duplicate clauses and repeated literals; this is not invariance to arbitrary logically redundant derived clauses
invariant_obligations: All surviving clauses logically equivalent as CNF to original source
All selected native XOR equations exact source mask semantics; unselected CNF retained
All original SAT models validated against original pre-normalization source
Reject malformed literals and illegal variable IDs
No claim of invariant to every SAT-equivalent CNF encoding

new_metamorphic_cohort.procedure: New deterministic variable-ID bijection, new per-variable polarity flips, new clause/literal order, then add ceil(tautology_percent*m/100) seeded tautological clauses and ceil(duplicate_clause_percent*m/100) shuffled/occasionally repeated-literal copies of existing original clauses; all additions preserve SAT and complete translated model. New seed distinct from 004E5 but all parents known to JANUS.

comparison.total_full_cold_time: Every child measures fresh Python import, exact archived original SHA check and source transforms, strict DIMACS reparse, optional structural scan and semantic normalization, solver setup, solution search, complete original-model replay; parent cold-subprocess wall.
comparison.fairness: Four arms, two repetitions, all on exact same virtual machine and transformed source identity. Same host paired SAT-success timing ratios allowed only for TWO completed verified SAT outputs. Timeout UNKNOWN, not UNSAT. Do not compare ratios across Ubuntu or different derived CNF cases.

hard_gates.negative_control: old_adaptive80 must continue to show known failure on taut+duplicate padding (diagnostic), native_all remains upper reference
